title: the cha-cha break: three hits out of silence, then the solo burns
story: At ~112 BPM the full band plays through 4862-5135 and the jigsaw board deals one step per beat on a terracotta palette, the colour swaying on each bar and a first small cha-cha-cha of pushes on 4886-4898-4915. At 5136 the band drops out and the room dims; then three hits come out of silence and each one changes the picture: 5176 (18.7) a deep push, a flash and a deal burst; 5294 (21.9, out of total silence) the board folds into a kaleido mandala with a shake and the brightest flash; 5358 (12.6) the board breaks apart under the deepest push. At 5410 the piano solo starts and the board burns: eighth-note deals, colliding pieces, nonstop sliding, and the palette turning on every beat through col_hue and col_bri. From 5479 the solo varies phrase by phrase, never the same state twice: bar 81 jumps the deals to paso 4.6 with vertical tiles and a warm flash; bar 82 shatters into an 8-fold mandala swung cold with horizontal tiles; bar 83 swings the hue hard warm then cold on each key turn and deals at their fastest; bar 84 peaks on a 9-fold mandala and the brightest flash at 5689, then settles into a burning loop. Every piano peak gets a hard shake, and posterize stabs mark the strongest.
